TooltipCommunicationView in Figma

The `m3e-tooltip` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Plain tooltip

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
[ M3e.iconButton
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Go back"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button"
]
[ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ]
, M3e.tooltip [ M3e.Tooltip.for "button" ] [ Kit.text "Go Back" ]
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Go back"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button"
]
[ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ]
, M3e.Tooltip.el { content = Kit.text "Go Back" } [ M3e.Tooltip.for "button" ] []
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Go back"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button"
]
[ M3e.Icon.build
|> M3e.Icon.withName "arrow_back"
|> M3e.Icon.toElement
]
, M3e.Tooltip.build { content = Kit.text "Go Back" }
|> M3e.Tooltip.withFor "button"
|> M3e.Tooltip.toElement
]
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Go back" id="button">
<m3e-icon name="arrow_back"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-tooltip for="button">Go Back</m3e-tooltip>

Delays

]
[ Kit.text "Go Back" ]
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view [ M3e.Attributes.id "button" ] [ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "arrow_back" ] [] ]
, M3e.Tooltip.el { content = Kit.text "Go Back" }
[ M3e.Tooltip.for "button"
, M3e.Tooltip.showDelay 0
, M3e.Tooltip.hideDelay 200
]
[]
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view [ M3e.Attributes.id "button" ]
[ M3e.Icon.build
|> M3e.Icon.withName "arrow_back"
|> M3e.Icon.toElement
]
, M3e.Tooltip.build { content = Kit.text "Go Back" }
|> M3e.Tooltip.withFor "button"
|> M3e.Tooltip.withShowDelay 0
|> M3e.Tooltip.withHideDelay 200
|> M3e.Tooltip.toElement
]
<m3e-icon-button id="button">
<m3e-icon name="arrow_back"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-tooltip for="button" show-delay="0" hide-delay="200">Go Back</m3e-tooltip>

Rich tooltip

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
[ M3e.iconButton
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Settings"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button2"
]
[ M3e.icon [ M3e.Icon.name "settings" ] [] ]
, M3e.richTooltip [ M3e.RichTooltip.for "button2" ]
[ M3e.RichTooltip.subhead (Kit.text "New settings available")
, Kit.text "Now you can adjust the uploaded image quality\n , and upgrade your available storage space."
]
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Settings"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button2"
]
[ M3e.Icon.view [ M3e.Icon.name "settings" ] [] ]
, M3e.RichTooltip.el { content = Kit.text "Now you can adjust the uploaded image quality\n , and upgrade your available storage space." } [ M3e.RichTooltip.for "button2" ] [ M3e.RichTooltip.subhead (Kit.text "New settings available") ]
]
[ M3e.IconButton.view
[ TypedHtml.Aria.label "Settings"
, M3e.Attributes.id "button2"
]
[ M3e.Icon.build
|> M3e.Icon.withName "settings"
|> M3e.Icon.toElement
]
, M3e.RichTooltip.build { content = Kit.text "Now you can adjust the uploaded image quality\n , and upgrade your available storage space." }
|> M3e.RichTooltip.withFor "button2"
|> M3e.RichTooltip.withSubhead (Kit.text "New settings available")
|> M3e.RichTooltip.toElement
]
<m3e-icon-button aria-label="Settings" id="button2">
<m3e-icon name="settings"></m3e-icon>
</m3e-icon-button>
<m3e-rich-tooltip for="button2">
<span slot="subhead">New settings available</span>
Now you can adjust the uploaded image quality, and upgrade your available storage space.
</m3e-rich-tooltip>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-tooltip produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type Position

The position values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type TouchGestures

The touchGestures values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Constructor
tooltip : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.Tooltip.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element M3e.Component.Tooltip.Content (M3e.Component.Tooltip.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.Tooltip.Is s) admittedBy msg

The loose m3e-tooltip producer — open attribute/child rows, no required record. See M3e.Component.Tooltip.component for the required-content form.
